features.name: Submission client and disclosures
features.description: API client that defaults to format-only, requires explicit confirmation and an idempotency key for scored uploads, archives every submitted file with its code hash, and generates the external-data disclosure text from EXTERNAL_DATA.md.
features.evidence: 2026-10-19: src/vec/submit.py with `vec submit FILE --board KEY` (format-only unless --official and --confirm equal to the file's sha256[:12]), `vec submit status` (read-only: phase, quota, ledger and server view per board, with resolve commands) and `vec submit resolve SHA12 --board KEY --as not-stored|acknowledged --note TEXT` (local, no token); 73 tests in tests/test_submit.py, 27 in tests/test_data.py. Built files are uploaded from the DGX with `vec submit PATH --board KEY --from-dgx` (the user's choice, 2026-10-19): the file is pulled over ssh into a private temporary copy for that call only (checked against the DGX's sha256 and size; removed on every exit, SIGHUP and SIGTERM included, and leftovers of killed calls cleared by the next call), the key never goes to the DGX, an official upload also needs the guard "dgx provenance" (DGX HEAD = local HEAD and a clean DGX tree), and the ledger's origin column records the DGX path and commit. A format check needs a phase whose split is the board's. An official upload also needs a clean tree (no uncommitted change to a tracked file and no untracked, non-ignored file outside results/, runs/ and experiments/**/results/; the ledger is exempt), EXTERNAL_DATA.md disclosure ids, an earlier passing server format check of the same file for the same board, a phase that takes the board's split, a readable quota (official_per_board) and submission list, and room in the board's budget (2 per board; rejected uploads refunded; server entries count by id, plus each file's ledger slots that no listed entry has settled; an upload with an unknown outcome counts, with no time limit, until an answer, a listing or a not-stored resolution settles it). A format check the server stored (UNEXPECTED_SUBMISSION) or left unconfirmed counts and blocks every POST to every board until resolved on each board it is recorded under; an official upload of a file the board already holds that way is refused. Each upload sends a private snapshot re-hashed against the plan; idempotency key vec.<board>.<sha256>, byte-identical retries, replays that send and settle nothing, no redirects, the token redacted from everything the server returns and refused if malformed; one ledger row per attempt in results/submissions.csv. Built by an agent, then three rounds of independent review and fixes (15 findings in round 1, all verified fixed). 2026-10-20: build stamps (a side agent noted that "dgx provenance" checks only the code checked out at upload time): vec.io.write_submission writes `<file>.stamp.json` for every prediction file (src/vec/provenance.py: sha256, size, commit, and whether the tree stayed clean from the build's start, recorded at the first import of vec.provenance, to the write, by the clean-tree rule and HEAD's reflog); an official upload needs the guard "build stamp" (the stamp matches the bytes sent, says clean, and its commit is the local HEAD or an ancestor), --from-dgx pulls the stamp with the file, and the ledger's build_commit column records it. Built by an agent, verified independently (a major gap, the start being read only at write time, reproduced and fixed), re-verified; 279 tests in tests/ (14 in tests/test_provenance.py), 203 in experiments/, all 50 T3 tests on the DGX. Open: the shape of official_per_board is unpublished, so official uploads stay refused until `vec submit status` reads it in the final phase; the client records each file's sha256 and commits but does not copy the file (the Dec 1-2 archive step copies each file with its stamp). 2026-10-20: first real uploads, while the validation phase runs a week longer (the final phase moved to 2026-10-27): three server format checks through `vec submit PATH --board KEY --from-dgx` of practice files built on the DGX at 6dca2c5 (`vec baseline copy_last|wt_identity --n-cells 1000`; T1:val, T2:heart:val_extrap, T3:gata4). Each came back HTTP 200 format_ok with no submission id, so the server honoured format_only=true and took each task's form fields (T1 task; T2 setting and mode; T3 target). `vec submit status` before and after: no server entry on any board, and the daily scored and upload counts stayed at 0 for every task. Ledger rows in results/submissions.csv carry the build commit and the DGX origin; no temporary copy was left behind. 2026-10-28 (as served since 2026-10-27): the final phase serves official_per_board (keys T1:test, T2:heart:test_extrap, T2:embryo:test_interp, T3:bcatenin; 0/2 used each), but the client reads a board's entry only for a board in boards/index.json, which still holds the P2 specs (runbook step 1, HTTP 403), so official uploads to the test boards stay refused until the specs are in.
